definition.en: One of the horizontal tucks running around a pollera near its hem — the full gathered skirt of Aymara and Quechua women of the Bolivian and Peruvian altiplano. The tucks ornament the skirt and are practical at the same time: letting them out lengthens the pollera as it is passed down or as fashion shifts.
definition.es: Uno de los pliegues horizontales que recorren una pollera cerca del ruedo — la falda amplia y fruncida de las mujeres aymaras y quechuas del altiplano boliviano y peruano. Las alforzas adornan la falda y a la vez son prácticas: soltarlas alarga la pollera cuando se hereda o cuando cambia la moda.
definition.fr: L'un des plis horizontaux qui font le tour d'une pollera près de son ourlet — la jupe ample et froncée des femmes aymaras et quechuas de l'altiplano bolivien et péruvien. Les plis ornent la jupe et sont en même temps pratiques : les défaire rallonge la pollera quand elle est transmise ou quand la mode change.
definition.pt: Uma das pregas horizontais que percorrem uma pollera junto à bainha — a saia ampla e franzida das mulheres aimarás e quíchuas do altiplano boliviano e peruano. As pregas ornamentam a saia e são ao mesmo tempo práticas: desfazê-las alonga a pollera quando é passada adiante ou quando a moda muda.

aliases.name: alforza_count / alforza_depth
aliases.note: Parameters of aymara-pollera-skirt, whose `alforza_hem` interface (type 'hem') carries them.

constraints: Each tuck eats twice its depth in cloth, so the cut length must include the take-up: `CUT_LENGTH = finished_length + alforza_count * alforza_depth * 2 + hem_allowance`. A draft that adds the tucks after solving the length delivers a skirt short by exactly the take-up.
sources: fashion-cabinet/projects/aymara-pollera-skirt/docs/README.md — provenance (the pollera of the cholita, worn over an enagua with a manta and a bowler hat; once imposed by colonial dress codes, now a deliberate marker of Aymara and Quechua identity) and the tuck take-up solve
